xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5124: Built-in defaults: mid workhorse to Opus 5.5; cheap workhorse and background calls to Haiku 5.5

plan.title: Built-in defaults: mid workhorse to Opus 5.5; cheap workhorse and background calls to Haiku 5.5
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One operator decision (issue body) about built-in default model values, which are mirrored across config defaults, module constants, the Anthropic preset, four Settings fallbacks, two test trees and five docs. Most edits are one-line value changes; the issue mandates a single PR whose checkpoint fallback ships FR-1 alone, and the subsystem count is inflated because the lint counts each top-level doc file as its own subsystem.

narratives.Problem: The built-in mid workhorse is Sonnet 5.5 although the 2026-09-29 eval found Opus 5.5 caught 3x the review blockers, and the cheap workhorse and background calls run Haiku 4.5 at 10x Haiku 5.5's price. Moving background calls to Haiku 5.5 also exposes three gaps: Haiku 5.5 thinks by default (titles pay for it; memory extraction can run out of max_tokens), background calls never run the Claude Code 2.1.293 minimum-version check, and compaction sizes chunks for the wrong model when no model is passed.
narratives.Proposal: Flip DEFAULT_WORKHORSES.mid to claude-opus-5-5 unconditionally. Add a low-effort pin (gated on the model's own effortLevels row) to title-family claude -p calls and Anthropic memory extraction, run prepareHarnessLaunch before both background claude spawns, list title/compaction models as Claude Code requirement sources, and resolve an empty compaction model to DEFAULT_SUMMARY_MODEL for chunk sizing. Then run the issue's 20+20 real-model checkpoint; on GO flip every cheap and background default (config, module constants, Anthropic preset v2, Settings fallbacks) to claude-haiku-5-5; on FALLBACK cancel those items. Update CONFIGURATION.md, MODEL_ROUTING.md, MODEL-CALLS.md, model-presets.mdx, harnesses.mdx and changelog.mdx to match.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing the claude-haiku-4-5 entries in src/lib/model-fallback.ts (cross-provider fallback targets and the L1 enrichment quick-model path).
- Changing tiered-execution crew or supervisor defaults (CrewRow.tsx DEFAULT_CREW_MODEL, TieredExecutionSection.tsx DEFAULT_MODEL and its "new crews start on Haiku 4.5" text).
- Removing Haiku 4.5 from providers.ts, settings.ts, model-capability-additions.ts, cost.ts or any picker; it stays selectable.
- Changing the expensive, flywheel, default-conversation, status-review, fork-summary, handoff-author or provider-fallback defaults.
- Pinning effort on smart compaction, fork summaries or handoff authoring.
- Setting an effort on the Anthropic trivial tier band, or adding a config key for background effort.
- Changing memory extraction max_tokens.
- Rewriting any operator config file; installs that set these keys keep their values.
- Changing the OpenAI preset.
- Catching ClaudeCodeTooOldError to retry a background call on another model.

autoDecisions.summary: FR-4: keep the existing claude-haiku-5-5 chunk row at 240,000 chars and fix the empty-model gap instead of resizing for the full 1M window (PRD D1).
autoDecisions.rationale: The row was added 2026-10-08 to stay under the 100K-token price tier; a 1M-token chunk would bill every token at 5x. The real defect is getChunkBudgetChars(undefined) sizing for a different model than runModelSummary runs.

autoDecisions.summary: FR-3 "classifier calls": docs.classifier has no runtime caller, so only its default value moves; the effort pin covers the title family (title, refinement, About) and Anthropic memory extraction/query expansion (PRD D3).
autoDecisions.rationale: grep finds no reader of docs.classifier.* outside config/presets. Haiku 5.5 thinking counts toward memory extraction's 2048 max_tokens and query expansion has a 750 ms budget, so leaving it unpinned would regress the new default.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate the low-effort pin on getModelEffortLevels(model)?.includes("low"), not supportedEffortLevels (PRD D2).
autoDecisions.rationale: supportedEffortLevels treats a model without a row as supporting all levels; Haiku 4.5 has no effortLevels and the Messages API rejects effort for it, so operators who keep 4.5 must see unchanged requests.

autoDecisions.summary: Background claude spawns call prepareHarnessLaunch("claude-code", { model }) and spawn the resolved binaryPath; ClaudeCodeTooOldError propagates to existing failure handling and may trigger the PAN-5108 auto-update (PRD D5-D7).
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the one existing refusal path with its exact message, checks the binary actually spawned, and keeps auto-update under the single machine-wide switch. Heuristic-summary fallback is not another model, so FR-5 is met.

autoDecisions.summary: listConfiguredModels also lists conversations.title_model and conversations.compaction_model (PRD D8).
autoDecisions.rationale: The dashboard banner and pan doctor then warn about an old Claude Code before the first background call fails; memory extraction uses the SDK and is excluded.

autoDecisions.summary: Bump the Anthropic preset to version 2, date 2026-11-11; cost-saver inherits it (PRD D9).
autoDecisions.rationale: The preset values change, and version exists so installs that applied v1 see updateAvailable.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep no effort on the Anthropic trivial tier band; change only the stale comment (PRD D10).
autoDecisions.rationale: presets.test.ts requires trivial effort undefined and any preset effort to be high; Haiku 5.5 then runs at its own default.

autoDecisions.summary: Update RolesPanel, the four Settings select fallbacks, both memory placeholders and FALLBACK_COMPACTION_MODEL; leave tiered-execution crew defaults (PRD D11).
autoDecisions.rationale: The former mirror the defaults this issue changes; the crew defaults are a separate setting the issue does not list.

autoDecisions.summary: The 20+20 checkpoint is its own item that gates every Haiku default flip and the docs; FR-1 never waits on it (PRD D12).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's fallback is "ship FR-1 alone"; encoding the gate as DAG edges with a stated GO/FALLBACK rule removes the judgment call from the executor.

autoDecisions.summary: Changelog entry goes in a new v0.78.0 Unreleased block, or an existing Unreleased block if one appeared (PRD D13).
autoDecisions.rationale: docs/RELEASING.md says to add the next Unreleased block once it has entries.
